svg.text: Phase 2 · step 5f · Places, the location picker, and About (decisions #038, #059): two options each
Places are each person's own aliases (Driver mode shown: no role needed). The picker is reused by milestone 6's event forms. Typed city and state are allowed (e.g. a base GeoNames doesn't list).
A · One list; Add and Edit open the place dialog (below)
Your places: only you see them. Inside one, a new event uses it.
Camp Lejeune, North Carolina, US · typed
Removing a place never changes past events: each event keeps its own copy.
Tap a place to edit it.
+ One dialog for add and edit,
B · List and detail (like Users and Groups): the chosen place on the right, edited in place
Changes save when a field is left.
− More screen for a short list;
The place dialog: the location picker (reused by milestone 6's events)
